""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML response by escaping user-provided content. Args: visitor_content: The raw string supplied by the user. Returns: A complete HTML page with the escaped content inserted. """ # Escape special characters to prevent injection (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
